evidence.title: Adapter-Based Few-Shot Continual Learning for Malicious Packet Recognition

summary: Researchers have introduced an adapter-based few-shot continual learning framework that can recognize malicious packets with limited labeled data and adapt to evolving threats. The approach combines adapter modules with continual learning to maintain high detection accuracy while reducing the need for extensive retraining.
title: New Adapter-Based Few-Shot Continual Learning Model Enhances Detection of Malicious Network Packets
